_doc: Per-model overrides for scripts/refresh/check_models.py. Keys match the 'model' field in api/v1/models.json. extra_urls are fetched IN ADDITION to the model's 'sources'. extract adds per-model signal regexes on top of the global ones. Entries are optional — models with no entry are checked using their models.json sources only.

defaults.user_agent: AI-Film-Guide-ModelWatch/1.0 (weekly freshness check; contact via repo)

DoP (Lite/Standard/Turbo).note: No source URLs yet. Add Higgsfield DoP page URL here when known.

Kling 2.5 Turbo.note: No source URLs; official Kling site.

Marketing Studio video.note: No source URLs yet. Add Higgsfield Marketing Studio page URL here when known.

Seedance 2.5.note: No source URLs; official ByteDance/Seedance landing page.

Sora 2 / Pro / Max.note: Status discontinued per models.json. Watch sources for resurrection/rebrand; flag any change for review.

Soul 2.0.note: Higgsfield landing page is marketing copy; signals are noisy. Treat changed=true as 'page changed', not 'model changed'.

Soul Cast.note: No source URLs in models.json; checked via Higgsfield homepage extra_url.

Wan 2.6.note: No source URLs; official Wan (Alibaba) site.
